status: Source-linked assertions; their presence is not a geometric or medical certification.

invariants: Cortex surrounds the medullary pyramids and extends between them as renal columns.
Papillary tips project into the minor calyces.
Minor calyces join major calyces, which communicate with the renal pelvis and ureter.
The hilar artery and vein remain distinct from the collecting system.
A coronal illustrative section is not an imaging-derived slice; laterality remains unspecified.
must_not_infer: Patient-specific numbers of pyramids or calyces
Microscopic glomeruli visible at gross anatomical scale
That vessel branching omitted from this plate is absent in the body

invariants: The medial concavity contains the hilum.
The external view does not expose renal pyramids or calyces.
The ureter leaves the collecting system, not the renal artery.
must_not_infer: Laterality from an unlabelled mirrored silhouette
Exact hilar depth order from a flattened isolated illustration

invariants: The lumen is bounded by the intimal region.
Media is outside intima; adventitia is outside media.
The internal elastic lamina lies at the intima-media boundary.
This drawing is a muscular artery, not every class of blood vessel.
must_not_infer: That a lumen highlight denotes an additional tissue layer

invariants: Epineurium surrounds the nerve trunk and occupies the spaces between fascicles.
Endoneurial connective tissue surrounds individual fibres within fascicles.
The view combines a cut face and a longitudinal surface and is explicitly illustrative.
must_not_infer: Actual fibre counts or fascicle arrangement
That every peripheral nerve fibre is myelinated
That repeated dots are measured histology
